descriptor_hash_semantics: Canonical descriptor bytes are the exact minified encoding/json output of this ordered map-free Go struct, not videoedit.CanonicalJSON or JCS. DescriptorHash is SHA-256 over u64be(len(descriptor-hash-profile)), exact profile UTF-8, u64be(len(those bytes)), and those exact bytes.
receipt_semantics: Receipt and RasterReceipt are unsigned serialized structural evidence and never authorize rendering by themselves. Only a live opaque Source returned by Assemble carries the private Layout and LayoutSource required by RasterizeStatic. Hash profiles must travel with every digest.
binding_encoding: str is u64be UTF-8 byte length followed by exact bytes; u16/u32/u64 are unsigned big-endian and i64 is its two's-complement u64 bit pattern. AssemblyHash order: domain, profile schema, receipt schema; profile, descriptor hash profile/value, assembly hash profile; frozen text profile/binding hash profile/value, document hash profile/value, text asset ID, font asset ID, font content hash profile/value, semantic hash profile/value, layout-input hash profile/value; provider profile/hash profile/value, dependency fingerprint profile/value, layout-graph hash profile/value, source-outline hash profile/value, layout-source hash profile/value; shape input hash profile/value, shape output profile/hash profile/value, layout receipt profile, glyph-stream hash profile/value, scaled-outline hash profile/value, placement hash profile/value, layout hash profile/value, shaping/paint/capability statuses; text/font indices, viewport, font size, fill, counts and resources. AssemblyHash itself is omitted. Raster BindingHash order: domain, profile schema, receipt schema; profile, descriptor hash profile/value, binding hash profile, assembly hash profile/value, inner receipt/raster/binding-hash profiles and binding hash, inner/outer shaping status, paint status, coverage hash profile/value, pixel hash profile/value, dimensions and resources. BindingHash itself is omitted.
assembly_semantics: Accept only an opaque live-replayed FrozenTextSource and a live ShapeProvider. Bind the provider's complete LayoutSource first, shape only the frozen text/run fields, cross-check every font/provider/graph/outline identity, derive the exact glyph closure, and privately build the deterministic Layout.
raster_semantics: RasterizeStatic is the only raster outlet. It supplies the package-private authenticated Layout and frozen static fill to textraster. The inner receipt remains caller-layout-unverified; the outer receipt authenticates shaping because callers cannot inject or retrieve that Layout.
ownership_semantics: A Source retains only opaque immutable trust roots, one immutable Layout, a scalar fill, and a scalar receipt. It exposes no shaped stream, outline, Layout, LayoutSource, slices, maps, readers, or low-level raster request.
failure_semantics: Nil, zero, mismatched or drifted trust roots, unsupported profiles, missing glyphs, malformed closure geometry, resource exhaustion, cancellation and panic fail closed with nil output and a strictly zero receipt.
resource_semantics: Let L=lines,G=glyphs,U=unique glyphs,C=commands,Q=command point occurrences,A=AssemblyHash preimage bytes,S=owned Receipt string bytes. BridgeWorking=65536+24L+84G+32U+48C+16Q and BridgeWork=L+8G+8U+U*bits.Len64(U)+4C+2Q+A. Assembly CanonicalBinaryBytes=LayoutSource.canonical+Shape.canonical+Layout.canonical+A; WorkUnits=LayoutSource.work+Shape.work+Layout.work+BridgeWork; RetainedBytes=FrozenText.retained+LayoutSource.retained+Layout.retained+4096+S+71; WorkingBytes=max(RetainedBytes,FrozenText.retained+LayoutSource.working+Shape.working+Layout.working+BridgeWorking). Child limits are capped before calls; map/scan pre-admission uses the safe G/U and source/layout-bounded C/Q envelope. For static raster with binding preimage R and owned RasterReceipt strings Z: canonical=inner.canonical+R, work=inner.work+R, retained=inner.retained+4096+Z+71, working=max(inner.working,retained). The wrapper precomputes exact inner canonical bytes while separately admitting textraster's deterministic 9*pixel_count+16384 inner upper. All arithmetic is checked uint64; limits never select lower quality.
cancellation_semantics: A non-nil context is checked before validation, around every provider child call, periodically inside line/glyph/outline/command/materialization loops, during every outer hash, and immediately before publication. Cancellation and unexpected panic return nil output and a strictly zero receipt; recovered values are never formatted or otherwise executed.
